basic_profile.bio: A recent college graduate from Istanbul, Turkey, who majored in Media Studies. I have a keen interest in indie music and love exploring new genres and artists. In my free time, I engage with crowdfunding projects, especially those related to music and tech. I'm a passionate supporter of Fenerbahçe SK and enjoy discussing football strategies and match outcomes. My curiosity also extends to cryptocurrency and finance. I usually browse Reddit during the late evenings. Currently, single and working as a freelance content creator.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained insights into digital media and music through academic coursework and personal exploration. My interest in crypto finance developed through online communities and self-study.
